mathematical_meanings: Left image: The dashed trace is the graph of g. Right image: The dashed arc draws the occluded part of the cylinder’s lower circular rim.
Rationales: The feature plots the values of a function in the left image and shows the occluded part of the circular rim of a solid in the right image. The dashed magenta parabola labeled g, with its vertex below the origin. The dashed rear part of the lower ellipse of the upright cylinder.
